categories.title: Built for every vehicle owner and
categories.text: RAVU begins with boda boda riders and Bajaj operators and expands across six connected vehicle and fleet categories so every member household and transport business benefits from collective scale.

items.title: Motorcycle & Boda Boda Riders
items.text: Boda boda operators, delivery riders, commercial motorcycle operators and private motorcycle owners.

items.title: Bajaj & Commercial Vehicle Drivers
items.text: Commercial & private Bajaj (three-wheeler) operators, taxi drivers, ride-hailing drivers and service vehicles.

items.title: Private Vehicle Owners & Families
items.text: Individual members and households owning sedans, SUVs, pickups and personal family vehicles.

items.title: Truck Owners & Logistics Operators
items.text: Cargo transport operators, long-haul trucking businesses, construction transport and distribution companies.

items.title: Bus Owners & Passenger Transit
items.text: Urban bus operators, intercity bus companies, school transport providers and staff shuttle services.

items.title: Fleet Owners & SMEs
items.text: Commercial, corporate, delivery, rental, logistics and motorcycle fleets accessing bulk parts & fleet insurance.

meaning.title: Your financial advantage
meaning.text: Rather than negotiating alone, RAVU members access structured corporate-grade discounts on insurance, spare parts, tires, batteries, lubricants and mechanical repairs.
items: Exclusive member pricing on motorcycle, Bajaj, private car, fleet, health and family insurance.
10%–25% OFF genuine spare parts, tires, batteries, lubricants and filters at partner suppliers.
5%–20% OFF routine maintenance, engine servicing, brakes and diagnostics at official garages.
Volume-based Fleet Discount Program for commercial transport, delivery and logistics operators.

cards.title: Your membership, verified instantly.
cards.text: Present your RAVU Member ID at participating insurers, spare parts shops, tire centers and garages for instant verification and transparent member pricing.

cards.title: Protection for you and your family.
cards.text: Beyond vehicle coverage and workshop discounts, RAVU membership extends into personal accident cover, family medical plans, education protection and claim-free loyalty rewards.

journey.title: A clear route
journey.text: Six simple steps from registration to everyday savings and protection.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Share your interest online or sign up directly in the RAVU mobile app.

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Select your mobility category — rider, driver, private vehicle owner or fleet operator.

steps.title: Verification
steps.text: Receive your verified RAVU Member ID for instant recognition at partner branches.

steps.title: Protect & Insure
steps.text: Access preferred member insurance rates (20%+ target discount) and flexible payment plans.

steps.title: Save on Maintenance
steps.text: Redeem 10%–25% spare parts discounts and 5%–20% garage servicing discounts.

steps.title: Grow with RAVU
steps.text: Lower operating costs, reduce vehicle downtime and build long-term financial security.

pilot.title: Dar es Salaam Strategic Pilot Cohort
pilot.text: RAVU is launching its initial pilot cohort of 200–500 verified riders, drivers and vehicle owners in Dar es Salaam before expanding nationwide. Register today to join the priority onboarding wave.
